engines.name: Google Maps
engines.description: Scrapes Google Maps search results (local businesses and places) for a query, or the details of a single place identified by place_id or data_cid.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Anything you would type into Google Maps. Only required when type is search.

params.name: type
params.label: Search type
params.help: search lists results for q; place returns a specific place (use with place_id, data_cid or data). Not needed with place_id or data_cid.

params.name: ll
params.label: GPS origin (ll)
params.help: Search origin as @latitude,longitude,zoom (e.g. @40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z) or @latitude,longitude,map_height (e.g. @43.8521864,11.2168835,10410m). Only for type=search. Cannot be used with location, lat, lon, z or m.

params.name: location
params.label: Location name
params.help: Place name whose coordinates become the search origin (encoded into ll). Use with z or m. Cannot be used with ll, lat or lon.

params.name: lat
params.label: Latitude
params.help: Latitude of the origin; requires lon. Use with z or m. Cannot be used with ll or location.

params.name: lon
params.label: Longitude
params.help: Longitude of the origin; requires lat. Use with z or m. Cannot be used with ll or location.

params.name: z
params.label: Zoom level
params.help: Zoom from 3 (fully zoomed out) to 30; most places support 18-23. Required with location or lat/lon unless m is given.

params.name: m
params.label: Map height (meters)
params.help: Map height in meters, 1 to 15028132. Required with location or lat/lon unless z is given.

params.name: nearby
params.label: Nearby bias
params.help: Bias results toward the given location. Recommended when q contains 'near me'; not recommended when q already names a location.

params.name: google_domain
params.label: Google domain
params.help: Google domain to use. Defaults to google.com.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419. See the Google Maps languages page.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr. Affects only Place Results.

params.name: data
params.label: Data filter (deprecated)
params.help: Deprecated filter string copied from a Google Maps URL (!4m5!3m4!1s + data_id + !8m2!3d + lat + !4d + lon). Use place_id or data_cid instead. Required when type=place and neither place_id nor data_cid is used.

params.name: place_id
params.label: Place ID
params.help: Unique Google Maps place reference; can be used alone. Cannot be combined with data_cid.

params.name: data_cid
params.label: Data CID
params.help: Google customer identifier (CID) of a place; can be used alone. Cannot be combined with place_id.

params.name: min_price
params.label: Minimum price
params.help: Lower bound of the price range, for places with numeric price data (cafes, restaurants, bars).

params.name: max_price
params.label: Maximum price
params.help: Upper bound of the price range, for places with numeric price data.

params.name: min_rating
params.label: Minimum rating
params.help: Preferred minimum rating; lower or unrated places may still appear with reduced relevance.

params.name: open_state
params.label: Open state
params.help: Filter by current status. Cannot be combined with open_on_day or open_at_hour.

params.name: open_on_day
params.label: Open on day
params.help: Filter by day of week open. Cannot be combined with open_state.

params.name: open_at_hour
params.label: Open at hour
params.help: Hour of day (24h) the place must be open; use with open_on_day, not with open_state.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Result offset in steps of 20 (0, 20, 40, ...). Recommended maximum is 100.

pagination.notes: Steps of 20; recommended max offset 100. serpapi_pagination.next gives the next URL.

engines.aira_use: Find companies, offices, coworking spaces, recruiters and interview venues near a city, get their phone, hours and rating, and pull the data_id for reviews and photos lookups.

engines.name: Google Maps Reviews
engines.description: Returns user reviews, topic keywords and place info for a Google Maps place identified by data_id or place_id.

params.name: data_id
params.label: Data ID
params.help: Google Maps data ID of the place (from the Google Maps API). One of data_id or place_id must be set.

params.name: place_id
params.label: Place ID
params.help: Unique Google Maps place reference (from Maps Local Results). One of data_id or place_id must be set.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sort and refine reviews. Total review count may vary by option.

params.name: topic_id
params.label: Topic ID
params.help: Filter reviews by topic; topic IDs are in the JSON response (topics[].id). Cannot be used with query.

params.name: query
params.label: Text filter
params.help: Filter reviews by text. Cannot be used with topic_id.

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Maximum number of results, 1 to 20.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for the next page, found at serpapi_pagination.next_page_token. The start offset parameter is discontinued by Google.

pagination.notes: num (1-20) controls page size; follow serpapi_pagination.next_page_token.

engines.aira_use: Read what employees and visitors say about a prospective employer's office, culture and management before applying or interviewing there.

engines.name: Google Maps Photos
engines.description: Extracts full-size images, thumbnails and user information of photos posted for a Google Maps place, optionally by category.

params.name: data_id
params.label: Data ID
params.help: Google Maps data ID of the place (from the Google Maps API).

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: category_id
params.label: Category ID
params.help: ID of a photo category from the categories array of a previous response; available categories vary by place.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for the next page, found at serpapi_pagination.next_page_token. Each page returns 20 results.

engines.aira_use: Preview the office, campus or interview venue before an onsite visit.

engines.name: Google Maps Photo Meta
engines.description: Returns metadata for a single Google Maps photo: the user who posted it, the place location and the posting date.

params.name: data_id
params.label: Photo data ID
params.help: Google Maps Photos data ID (from the Google Maps Photos API).

engines.aira_use: Verify when and where a workplace photo was taken to judge how current the office impression is.

engines.name: Google Maps Posts
engines.description: Returns the posts (updates, events, offers) a business published on its Google Business Profile.

params.name: data_id
params.label: Data ID
params.help: Google Maps data ID of the place (from the Google Maps API).

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for the next page, found at serpapi_pagination.next_page_token. Each page returns 10 results.

engines.aira_use: Follow a target employer's recent announcements, hiring events and open days.

engines.name: Google Maps Directions
engines.description: Returns routes, step-by-step directions, distances and durations between two points for several travel modes.

params.name: start_addr
params.label: Start address
params.help: Starting point; anything valid in a Google Maps directions search. Alternatives: start_data_id or start_coords.

params.name: start_data_id
params.label: Start data ID
params.help: Data ID of the starting place (from the Google Maps API). Alternatives: start_addr or start_coords.

params.name: start_coords
params.label: Start coordinates
params.help: Start GPS as latitude,longitude, e.g. 30.197471099,-97.66635289. Alternatives: start_addr or start_data_id.

params.name: end_addr
params.label: End address
params.help: Destination; anything valid in a Google Maps directions search. Alternatives: end_data_id or end_coords.

params.name: end_data_id
params.label: End data ID
params.help: Data ID of the destination place. Alternatives: end_addr or end_coords.

params.name: end_coords
params.label: End coordinates
params.help: Destination GPS as latitude,longitude. Alternatives: end_addr or end_data_id.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: travel_mode
params.label: Travel mode
params.help: Mode of travel.

params.name: distance_unit
params.label: Distance unit
params.help: Unit for displayed distances.

params.name: avoid
params.label: Avoid
params.help: Route features to avoid; comma-join multiple. Allowed: highways, tolls, ferries.

params.name: prefer
params.label: Preferred transit types
params.help: Only with travel_mode=3; comma-join multiple. Allowed: bus, subway, train, tram_light_rail.

params.name: route
params.label: Transit route preference
params.help: Only with travel_mode=3.

params.name: time
params.label: Departure / arrival time
params.help: depart_at:<unix timestamp>, arrive_by:<unix timestamp>, or last_available (last transit; only with travel_mode=3).

engines.aira_use: Plan the commute or the trip to an onsite interview and compare driving, transit, cycling and walking times.

engines.name: Google Maps Autocomplete
engines.description: Returns Google Maps autocomplete suggestions for a partial query around a given GPS origin.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Text used to generate completion suggestions.

params.name: ll
params.label: GPS origin (ll)
params.help: Required. @latitude,longitude,zoom (3z to 21z) or @latitude,longitude,map_height in meters, e.g. @40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: cp
params.label: Cursor position
params.help: Cursor position within the query, starting at 0. Defaults to the end of the query.

engines.aira_use: Type-ahead for company, office and venue names when building a search form for employers.

engines.name: Google Maps Contributor Reviews
engines.description: Returns the reviews written by a single Google Maps contributor along with the contributor's profile and contribution counts.

params.name: contributor_id
params.label: Contributor ID
params.help: Google Maps contributor ID: the digits in the contributor reviews URL.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: num
params.label: Results
params.help: Maximum number of results to return. Must not exceed 200.

pagination.notes: Only num (max 200) is documented; no page token is listed.

engines.aira_use: Check whether a reviewer of an employer or venue is a credible local guide before trusting their feedback.

engines.name: Google Local
engines.description: Scrapes Google's local results (the tbm=lcl local finder) for a query, with optional place lookup by Google CID.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Anything you could use in a regular Google Local search.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates; city level recommended. Cannot be used with uule. See the /locations.json API.

params.name: uule
params.label: UULE
params.help: Google-encoded location. Cannot be used with location. Coordinate-based uule needs a matching gl.

params.name: google_domain
params.label: Google domain
params.help: Google domain to use. Defaults to google.com.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: ludocid
params.label: Google CID (ludocid)
params.help: Google CID of a place (place_id in Local/Search results, data_cid in Maps results), e.g. 14414772292044717666.

params.name: tbs
params.label: Advanced search options (tbs)
params.help: Advanced search options that cannot be expressed in q.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Number of results to skip. Pages hold 10 or 20 results, so step by that amount. Using serpapi_pagination.next is recommended.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device type to emulate.

pagination.notes: Page sizes are 10 or 20 depending on device; prefer serpapi_pagination.next.

engines.aira_use: Discover local employers, staffing agencies and coworking spaces in a target city as an alternative to Maps.

engines.name: Google Local Services
engines.description: Returns Google Local Services Ads (Google Guaranteed / Screened providers) for a service near a place. US places only.

params.name: q
params.label: Service
params.help: The service to search for (see the supported queries list), e.g. electrician.

params.name: data_cid
params.label: Place CID
params.help: Google CID of a city or district (place_id in Maps/Search/Local results), e.g. 14414772292044717666. Returns empty results outside the USA. Not the same as cid.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: job_type
params.label: Job type
params.help: Subcategory of the searched service, e.g. restore_power for electrician (see the job types list).

params.name: cid
params.label: Business CID
params.help: Unique place ID from the JSON response; used with bid and pid to open a specific business.

params.name: bid
params.label: Business BID
params.help: Unique place ID from the JSON response; used with cid and pid.

params.name: pid
params.label: Business PID
params.help: Unique place ID from the JSON response; used with cid and bid.

engines.aira_use: Find vetted local service providers for relocation, home-office setup or short-term moves when taking a new job.

engines.name: Google Flights
engines.description: Returns flight options, prices, layovers, emissions and price insights from Google Flights, plus booking options for a selected itinerary.

params.name: departure_id
params.label: Departure
params.help: Departure airport code (3 uppercase letters) or location kgmid (starts with /m/ or /g/). Comma-separate several, e.g. CDG,ORY,/m/04jpl.

params.name: arrival_id
params.label: Arrival
params.help: Arrival airport code or location kgmid; comma-separate several.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: currency
params.label: Currency
params.help: Currency code for returned prices (see the Google Travel Currencies page).

params.name: type
params.label: Trip type
params.help: Trip type. Round-trip return flights require a departure_token. With 3 use multi_city_json.

params.name: outbound_date
params.label: Outbound date
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD. Required when type is 1 or 2 (unless selected_flights_json is used). Not allowed when type is 3.

params.name: return_date
params.label: Return date
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD. Required when type is 1 (unless selected_flights_json is used). Not allowed when type is 2 or 3.

params.name: travel_class
params.label: Travel class
params.help: Cabin class.

params.name: multi_city_json
params.label: Multi-city legs (JSON)
params.help: JSON array for type=3; each object has departure_id, arrival_id, date (YYYY-MM-DD) and optional times.

params.name: show_hidden
params.label: Show hidden results
params.help: Include hidden results ('View more flights' on Google Flights).

params.name: exclude_basic
params.label: Exclude basic economy
params.help: Exclude basic-economy fares. Works only for US domestic flights; requires gl=us and travel_class=1.

params.name: deep_search
params.label: Deep search
params.help: Return results matching the Google Flights browser at the cost of longer response times.

params.name: adults
params.label: Adults
params.help: Number of adults.

params.name: children
params.label: Children
params.help: Number of children.

params.name: infants_in_seat
params.label: Infants in seat
params.help: Number of infants in seat.

params.name: infants_on_lap
params.label: Infants on lap
params.help: Number of infants on lap.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Result sort order.

params.name: stops
params.label: Stops
params.help: Stop limit.

params.name: exclude_airlines
params.label: Exclude airlines
params.help: Comma-separated airline IATA codes, or alliances STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD. Cannot be used with include_airlines.

params.name: include_airlines
params.label: Include airlines
params.help: Comma-separated airline IATA codes, or alliances STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD. Cannot be used with exclude_airlines.

params.name: bags
params.label: Carry-on bags
params.help: Number of carry-on bags; must not exceed passengers with carry-on allowance (adults, children, infants_in_seat).

params.name: max_price
params.label: Max price
params.help: Maximum ticket price. Unlimited by default.

params.name: outbound_times
params.label: Outbound times
params.help: 2 numbers (departure window) or 4 numbers (departure and arrival windows), each an hour 0-23, e.g. 4,18,3,19.

params.name: return_times
params.label: Return times
params.help: Same format as outbound_times. Only valid when type is 1.

params.name: emissions
params.label: Emissions
params.help: Emissions filter.

params.name: layover_duration
params.label: Layover duration (min)
params.help: Layover range in minutes as two comma-separated numbers, e.g. 90,330.

params.name: exclude_conns
params.label: Exclude connections
params.help: Comma-separated connecting airport codes to exclude.

params.name: max_duration
params.label: Max duration (min)
params.help: Maximum flight duration in minutes, e.g. 1500. If no results come back, increase by up to 200.

params.name: selected_flights_json
params.label: Selected flights (JSON)
params.help: JSON object pinning the itinerary: outbound array (required) and return array (round trips); each segment has flight_number, departure_id, arrival_id, date. Cannot be used with departure_token, booking_token or multi_city_json.

params.name: departure_token
params.label: Departure token
params.help: Selects a flight from the departure results and returns the return flights (round trip) or next leg (multi-city). Cannot be used with booking_token.

params.name: booking_token
params.label: Booking token
params.help: Returns booking options for selected flights; date and advanced filters are ignored. Cannot be used with departure_token.

pagination.notes: Not paginated; step through legs with departure_token and booking_token.

engines.aira_use: Price flights to onsite interviews or relocation, see whether fares are low versus typical, and get booking options.

engines.name: Google Flights Autocomplete
engines.description: Returns airport, city and region suggestions (with IDs usable as departure_id / arrival_id) for a partial query.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Text used to generate autocomplete suggestions.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: exclude_regions
params.label: Exclude regions
params.help: Remove region-level locations (countries, sub-national regions, multi-country areas) from suggestions.

engines.aira_use: Resolve city or airport names to codes for the flight search form when planning interview travel.

engines.name: Google Flights Deals
engines.description: Returns flight deals from a departure point as shown in Google Flights Explore deals, optionally from a natural-language query or flexible dates.

params.name: departure_id
params.label: Departure
params.help: Departure airport code (3 uppercase letters) or location kgmid (/m/ or /g/); comma-separate several.

params.name: query
params.label: Natural-language query
params.help: e.g. 'beach vacation next month'. Cannot be combined with travel_duration or trip_length.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: currency
params.label: Currency
params.help: Currency code for returned prices (see the Google Travel Currencies page).

params.name: type
params.label: Trip type
params.help: Flight type.

params.name: travel_class
params.label: Travel class
params.help: Cabin class.

params.name: outbound_date
params.label: Outbound date(s)
params.help: One YYYY-MM-DD date (exact) or two comma-separated dates (flexible window). If omitted, deals for any date are returned.

params.name: return_date
params.label: Return date(s)
params.help: One date or a two-date window. Not for one-way. Single pairs with a single outbound_date, range with a range. Cannot be combined with travel_duration or trip_length.

params.name: travel_duration
params.label: Trip duration
params.help: Preset trip duration for flexible dates. Not for one-way; cannot be combined with return_date, trip_length or query.

params.name: trip_length
params.label: Trip length (days)
params.help: Custom trip length in days: a single number or min,max range; each at least 1. Not for one-way; cannot be combined with return_date, travel_duration or query.

params.name: adults
params.label: Adults
params.help: Number of adults.

params.name: children
params.label: Children
params.help: Number of children.

params.name: infants_in_seat
params.label: Infants in seat
params.help: Number of infants in seat.

params.name: infants_on_lap
params.label: Infants on lap
params.help: Number of infants on lap.

params.name: stops
params.label: Stops
params.help: Maximum number of stops.

params.name: exclude_airlines
params.label: Exclude airlines
params.help: Comma-separated 2-character IATA codes or alliances STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD. Cannot be used with include_airlines.

params.name: include_airlines
params.label: Include airlines
params.help: Comma-separated 2-character IATA codes or alliances. Cannot be used with exclude_airlines.

params.name: max_price
params.label: Max price
params.help: Maximum ticket price. Unlimited by default.

params.name: max_duration
params.label: Max duration (min)
params.help: Maximum flight duration in minutes, e.g. 1500. If no results, increase by up to 200.

engines.aira_use: Spot discounted flights to cities where you are interviewing or considering relocating.

engines.name: Google Hotels
engines.description: Returns hotel and vacation-rental search results with prices, ratings and amenities from Google Hotels, or full details of one property via property_token.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Anything you would use in a Google Hotels search. Not required when property_token is set; if both are set q is ignored.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Two or three letter language code, optionally with a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: currency
params.label: Currency
params.help: Currency code for returned prices (see the Google Travel Currencies page).

params.name: check_in_date
params.label: Check-in date
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: check_out_date
params.label: Check-out date
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: adults
params.label: Adults
params.help: Number of adults.

params.name: children
params.label: Children
params.help: Number of children.

params.name: children_ages
params.label: Children ages
params.help: Ages 1-17 (under 1 counts as 1), single value or comma-separated e.g. 5,8,10. Count must match children.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sort order. Default is relevance.

params.name: min_price
params.label: Min price
params.help: Lower bound of the price range.

params.name: max_price
params.label: Max price
params.help: Upper bound of the price range.

params.name: property_types
params.label: Property types
params.help: Single ID or comma-separated IDs, e.g. 17 or 17,12,18. Hotel and vacation-rental ID lists are on the Property Types pages; the options shown may not be exhaustive.

params.name: amenities
params.label: Amenities
params.help: Single ID or comma-separated IDs, e.g. 35 or 35,9,19. Options shown are the hotel amenity IDs; vacation rentals use a different list (Hot tub 2, Air-conditioned 4, Outdoor grill 6, Fireplace 10, Patio or deck 12, Kitchen 15, Fitness centre 16, Cot 18, Beach access 20, Child-friendly 21, Pet-friendly 24, Free Wi-Fi 29, Pool 32).

params.name: rating
params.label: Minimum rating
params.help: Minimum guest rating.

params.name: brands
params.label: Brand IDs
params.help: Brand IDs to focus on, single or comma-separated e.g. 33,67,101 (from brands[].id). Hotels only.

params.name: hotel_class
params.label: Hotel class
params.help: Star class filter, single or comma-separated e.g. 2,3,4. Hotels only.

params.name: free_cancellation
params.label: Free cancellation
params.help: Only results with free cancellation. Hotels only.

params.name: special_offers
params.label: Special offers
params.help: Only results with special offers. Hotels only.

params.name: eco_certified
params.label: Eco-certified
params.help: Only eco-certified results. Hotels only.

params.name: vacation_rentals
params.label: Vacation rentals
params.help: Switch the search to Vacation Rentals (default is Hotels).

params.name: bedrooms
params.label: Min bedrooms
params.help: Minimum bedrooms. Vacation rentals only.

params.name: bathrooms
params.label: Min bathrooms
params.help: Minimum bathrooms. Vacation rentals only.

params.name: next_page_token
